Ascended Headmaster.text: = Ascended Headmaster = == Name == Ascended Headmaster == Tips == "This is... the Headmaster of The School, the one that *actually* won the Tournament of Magic... I can't possibly think of any foe stronger than them...! At various phases in the fight, they will change their weapon, and with it, their strategy will shift a lot! Let's make sure to have, at least: one or two Potions of Revival, one or two Stunning Runes, an Amulet of Stun Protection ready to be equipped, and the Anti-Crit Ritual active. Dispelling Salves can also come in handy, and both the Time Dilation and Knockout spells should be extra useful. Let's watch out for these deadly attacks: Nova (very powerful!), Big Bang (extremely powerful, guaranteed instant defeat!), Titan (extremely powerful buff! Stun this one, or cast Petrification right after they use it!). The Thunder Whip will stun very often which can be very dangerous - make sure you are protected against stunning when they equip it!" == isBoss == 1 == Level == 80 == maxHP == 150000000 == attack == 5000 == attackDelay == 0.7 == accuracy == 500 == dodge == 500 == crit == 2 [[:Category:Bestiary|Back to Bestiary]] [[Category:Bestiary]] [[Category:Monster]]

Elements.text:
Each magicians life starts with choosing your primary element. In Magic Research 2 the first selection has to be done between the four elements Fire, Earth, Water and Air. Further research, completing [[Storylines|Storyline]] quests and retiring for a fresh start gives you the choice between an increasing collection of Elements.

'''Gold''' (also referred to as '''coins''' or '''money''') is part of the resources and used as currency for purchasing various additions the home aswell as requirement for several storylines. 

== Storing Gold ==
Gold is stored in the players home. To increase the amount a player is able to hold '''Safes''' may be bought. Additionally '''Enhancements''' and '''Spells''' may be unlocked to further increase the efficency of safes.

Magic Research 2 (May 21 2024) Wiki.text:
'''Welcome to the {{SITENAME}}!'''
'''Experience the long-awaited sequel to Magic Research!''' In Magic Research 2, you are a rookie wizard with a single ambition: to find or create the Philosopher's Stone, a legendary magical item that is said to be able to cure any illness. As you do so, you will learn more than you ever imagined about Magic and about the world around you. What kinds of adventures await you? Newest game by Maticolotto Magic Research 2. This game is the successor to the popular Magic Research game. Steam link: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2864890/Magic_Research_2/. Here you can purchase the full game or play the demo. The game is also available on the Google Play Store '''Before you start reading:''' Please keep in mind this is a wiki, a site dedicated to documenting the information of the game, so there will no doubt be spoilers if you read this before completing the game. Magic Research can seem obtuse or confusing at times, but helpful information you will need can be found in-game using the help menu. The first thing to try when you're stuck is to complete any [[Storylines|Story-line]] you can. Spoiling yourself with the wiki will dampen your enjoyment. We're a collaborative community website about Magic Research 2 that anyone, including you, can build and expand. Wikis like this one depend on readers getting involved and adding content. Click the "ADD NEW PAGE" or "EDIT" button at the top of any page to get started! == Recent Updates == ''Useful Links'' *[[Storylines|All Storylines]] *Transmutation *[[Elements]] *[[:Category:Spell|Spells]] *[[Classes]] *Compendium **[[Items]] **[[Bestiary]] You can also be part of the larger Fandom family of communities. Let your readers know what your topic is about and add some general information about it. Then you should visit [[Special:AdminDashboard|the admin dashboard for more tips]]. Mindbender.text: = Mindbender = == Name == Mindbender == Tips == "The Mindbender! This is who we were chasing throughout the Pyramid! A powerful spellcaster specializing on the Mind element. It is quite slow, but powerful - it has high :attack:, but its :hp: is not as high as the Avian Elephant... But it seems to be able to summon or call a Fire Spirit, like it did with the Sand Dweller - we should be extremely careful! When fighting the Fire Spirit, let's be particularly wary of Infernal Blaze, as it can deal extremely high damage - if we can Guard it (requires Earth Lv12) and/or if we can somehow make ourselves Wet before it hits, we could mitigate much of this. High :dodge: might also be effective for the Fire Spirit, but it will not be too effective against the actual Mindbender because of True Strike... Let's make sure we have good equipment and we are using as many buff spells as possible. If we still cannot get through, perhaps exploring that Sphinx - if we haven't done so yet - might hold a way for us to get stronger...?" == isBoss == 1 == Level == 32 == maxHP == 10000 == attack == 125 == attackDelay == 2.8 == accuracy == 100 == dodge == 100 == CoinsAwardedBase == 1799 == MonstiumAwardedBase == 800 == Drops == === Monstium Paper === * Amount: 1 * Chance: 100% [[:Category:Bestiary|Back to Bestiary]] [[Category:Bestiary]] [[Category:Monster]]

It will use Water attacks that also hit itself. This will make them Wet, which will reduce the effectivity of your Fire attacks. It also seems to have a really strong Tsunami attack... watch out! The Guard skill might come in handy, if your Earth is Lv12 or higher." == isBoss == 1 == Level == 13 == maxHP == 3000 == attack == 40 == attackDelay == 2.5 == accuracy == 100 == dodge == 100 == CoinsAwardedBase == 99 == MonstiumAwardedBase == 60 == Drops == === Copper Ore === * Amount: 4 * Chance: 100% [[:Category:Bestiary|Back to Bestiary]] [[Category:Bestiary]] [[Category:Monster]]

Man-Eating Plant.text: = Man-Eating Plant = == Name == Man-Eating Plant == Tips == "This giant plant is unbelievably strong. It might be the hardest fight we have done so far. Very strong attacks, very strong poison. Using Antidote (needs Poison Lv7) can certainly help us here, too, as we can neutralize the very strong poison it has. But the worst part is that it mutates into even more dangerous forms eventually! I wonder if higher :defense: would help us on the later forms..." == isBoss == 1 == Level == 20 == maxHP == 8000 == attack == 60 == attackDelay == 2.8 == accuracy == 100 == dodge == 100 == CoinsAwardedBase == 500 == MonstiumAwardedBase == 200 [[:Category:Bestiary|Back to Bestiary]] [[Category:Bestiary]] [[Category:Monster]]

Lytha, Doom Sorceress.text: = Lytha, Doom Sorceress = == Name == Lytha, Doom Sorceress == Tips == "The Doom Sorceress! Unbelievably strong. She will Silence Life periodically, which means we will have a hard time healing; unless there is something we could do about it, of course. Watch out for Wide Impending Doom: it will leave us critically injured, so if we can stun her when she is preparing the attack, that'll help! She will also use Intoxicate fairly often - and it is pretty deadly, so let's make sure to heal it every time. This fight is very difficult... and I think she is not even showing her full strength when it begins! If we can't beat her even with the best equipment we have, and while minding those attacks, perhaps it might be time to retire...? Storylines.text:
During the game, you will encounter various events (pop-up notifications or the bell in the top right). Completing these events can lead to unlocking new powers or elements. These storylines are persistent across retirements but will be reset upon entering a new world. For storylines which have the same name, you can only unlock one per retirement. Hints on unlocking the story-line are given at various levels of [[Mind]] mastery.

Story lines with "Explore xy" as condition will occur with a certain chance when exploring that said area. Trigger for this are random occurrences appearing every few minutes. The mind spell "[[Foresight]]" can show you when the next event will appear. The mind spell "[[Bend the Odds]]" can help you raise the chance to trigger the Storyline event.

The Headmaster.text: = The Headmaster = == Name == The Headmaster == Tips == The *Headmaster* of the School that won the Tournament of Magic! He is extremely powerful, and most likely the strongest opponent you have faced so far! He is proficient in Fire, Earth, Water and Air, and will switch between them in order - and focus its spells on that element. Watch out for some of his strongest spells: Firestorm, Fissure, and Blinding Speed. If you have a way to stun him, stunning his "Shift" attack will make him continue on his current element, which could be useful! You may also find manually casting the spells Soak (requires Water Lv25) and Soar (requires Air Lv37) to be useful in the Fire and Earth phases, as well as Guard (requires Earth Lv12) throughout the battle. If all of that is not enough, hunting for more Storylines, getting a few more Element levels, or even just getting stronger equipment might do the trick. I think we might stand a chance! And yet, it\'s odd... he is certainly very powerful, but I was expecting the Headmaster to be *much stronger* than this, so... what is going on?' == isBoss == 1 == Level == 60 == maxHP == 500000 == attack == 450 == attackDelay == 1.6 == accuracy == 165 == dodge == 165 == CoinsAwardedBase == 100000 == MonstiumAwardedBase == 10000 [[:Category:Bestiary|Back to Bestiary]] [[Category:Bestiary]] [[Category:Monster]]

Zeth King.text: = Zeth King = == Name == Zeth King == Tips == "The ruler of the long lost Zeth! ...Do we stand a chance? It is just... too *powerful*... Consider casting the Water spell Soak over and over to resist its deadly Fire spells. Be careful - it can also render itself immune to all status effects, too - and use Wide Soul Collapse on us, which is *guaranteed* to defeat us!
